MYRO1.0.0 - XBOX STARTUP FIX

Extract and run Apply-Update.cmd against your54.1.0 ISO, then upload the resulting
MyRO-Current.iso as usual. This patch accepts54.1.0 only. Existing saves and
settings remain in their existing directories; renaming the version does not
reset characters.

The first menu fade used a4-byte linear-texture pitch. Replace it with a
64-byte pitch and16 identical pixels per alpha row, preserving the appearance.
This corrects a hardware-invalid setting that xemu accepted. Native build,
texture-layout and updater checks pass; actual Xbox confirmation is pending.

This is the isolated startup correction. Requested title text, character
selection/creation, hairstyles/colors, per-stick tolerance and testing-menu/NPC
changes remain in the following update. No camera or gameplay changes here.

1.1.0 APPEARANCE RESOURCES

Run Collect-Appearance.cmd. Send the appearance ZIP part(s) AND the separate
font-reference ZIP created on your Desktop, even if a report says PARTIAL.

The27original hair SPR/ACT styles are already received. This requests their
original colour palettes (identical previously collected palettes are skipped).
The installed Windows Arial/Tahoma/Gulim files are optional font references,
needed because no original font files were in the earlier game collections.
Only these named files and palettes are copied. Client archives and Windows
fonts are read only. No personal files, accounts, saves or system settings
are collected or changed. Native font selection will be checked against the
original game appearance; this is not an installation or replacement of fonts.

Also requests bgm/01.mp3, the original login theme, which is not in the map
music collection. No repeat map or general sound collection is needed.

MYRO v1.1.0

Extract this update and run Apply-Update.cmd. Select your v1.0.0 ISO, then upload
MyRO-Current.iso to your Xbox using your normal method. Only v1.0.0 is accepted.
The updater verifies input/output, keeps a backup, and leaves saves/preferences
in their existing Save54_1_0 directories. No camera/projection changes.

- Stylist beside Grumble in the Teacher's room, southwest central Prontera.
  Each hairstyle, hair-colour or clothing-colour service costs500 Zeny when
  confirmed. Preview is free; B cancels. No charge for the current look or an
  unavailable palette.27 original hairstyles,9 colours; alternate clothing dyes
  appear only for classes whose original palettes are supplied. Other optional
  palettes are recorded for a later update.
- Y inspects inventory items/cards or equipped gear; up/down scrolls, Y/B closes.
  All538 cards have original English descriptions. Existing unidentified gear
  must be identified to reveal its properties. Some other items retain their
  existing descriptions where original English descriptions were not supplied.
- Pause > Gameplay > Auto loot controls pickup; Loot messages is separate.
  With auto-loot off, or when the bag is full/too heavy, rolled items remain on
  the ground. Original icons have green frames, world-depth tested. R3/X/Y target
  nearby enemies and items; A or either assigned quick action picks up a selected
  item. The character walks into range around obstacles. B/manual movement cancels
  the approach; failed pickup leaves the item in place. Floor items remain across
  map changes in this play session; they are not saved across quitting/loading.
- Flat drop multipliers: common5x,equipment2x,normal cards2x,MVP cards7.5x.
  Normal cards use the final requested2x rate; MVP cards remain7.5x.
  No level/status scaling of drop rates.
  EXP still scales1x at Base1 to30x at Base90.
- Windowless title lettering with outline/shadow and an Xbox A symbol; compact
  selectors; original login music; optional soft Poring navigation sounds in AV.
- Character selection alignment, static previews in all occupied slots, corrected
  information rows. Creation has a six-point stat web, Gender, hairstyle/colour.
- Independent left/right stick tolerance0-50percent,2percent steps, in AV/Settings.
- Developer/Testing entries are hidden until the title-screen Konami Code.
  Synthetic test NPCs in central Prontera removed; original NPCs retained.
- Training NPC controls rewritten for the controller without changing quest
  rewards, progression conditions or menu choice order.
- Save warning clears after successful saves/loads; busy NPC scripts defer
  autosave instead of reporting a new disk error.
- Original Play Dead icons, Novice job-level prompt, Basic Info bottom spacing,
  and shared clear Tahoma reference glyphs.

Sitting recovery follows the game rules: natural HP/SP recovery pauses at50percent
weight, including while sitting. Below that, sitting HP ticks every3seconds and
SP every4seconds, subject to normal status effects.

Native Xbox build, focused runtime/save/render checks and the actual shipped
PowerShell ISO updater are validated. Physical Xbox and xemu play-testing of
this new version remains for you. v1.0.0's hardware-safe startup fade is retained.

MYRO v1.1.1 - CHARACTER FOOT ALIGNMENT

Run Apply-Update.cmd against your v1.1.0 ISO, then upload MyRO-Current.iso
with your normal method. Saves and all existing assets are retained.

The new appearance container used canvas origin100 for first-class bodies,
while their established anchor90 requires origin80. This placed the body20pixels
below its original foot anchor, allowing the terrain to hide the feet.

Restore the original anchor-relative body and hair origin when loading the
appearance container, keeping source pixel/material offsets consistent when
clipping rows at the top. Other actor origins, camera, terrain, depth rules,
headgear attachment anchors, equipment, drop rates and quests are unchanged.
All186body variants/53096frames pass native bounds/composition checks, including
all21Novice/first-class variants. Native Xbox build and shipped updater verified.
Physical Xbox play-test of this correction remains for you.

MyRO v1.1.2 - Character creation appearance grids

Apply this patch to MyRO v1.1.1 using Apply-Update.cmd.
Select your current ISO. The updater verifies it, creates a backup and writes
MyRO-Current.iso. Transfer the updated game to your Xbox as usual.

Character creation now shows all 27 hairstyles and nine hair colours in two
selection panels inside the main window, using original head graphics.
Select a panel with A or Right. Use the D-pad to preview choices, A to keep
the choice, or B to undo it. The main portrait updates as you browse.
The name, Gender, Create button and starting-stat controls fit within the window.

Includes the v1.1.1 gameplay feet correction. Save format remains unchanged.
Native Xbox build, grid/asset checks and actual ISO updater verified.
Original Xbox visual testing remains for you to confirm.

The expanded-class asset upload has been verified and imported for the
separate v1.2.0 NPC/class update; those classes are not activated by this patch.

MyRO 1.10.0 targeted campaign cast / portrait collector

Run Collect-Campaign-Cast-Portraits.cmd. Select your usual RO client if asked.
Collects exactly four missing original Sealed Shrine portrait images and the
female Sage SPR/ACT pair for campaign scholars. No map trees, saves, account
data or uploads. Client archives are opened read-only. Send all generated ZIP
parts even if the report says PARTIAL; a missing file is not called complete.

MyRO 1.10.0 targeted story reference collector

Run Collect-Story-References.cmd. Collects named original Fenrir, Chaos, Iris
and Loki portraits, plus the female Wizard SPR/ACT pair. These references
help keep adapted story portraits faithful and complete companion job visuals.
No already-returned Sealed Shrine or female Sage files are requested again.
Client files are read-only; no account/save data or network upload. Send every
generated ZIP part even if the report is partial.

MYRO v1.10.0 — DEVELOPMENT CHECKPOINT

Apply this patch to the released 1.9.3 ISO only. Extract the entire ZIP and run
Apply-Update.cmd. It builds MyRO-Current.iso for your usual Xbox/xemu process.
Folder installs: transfer ALL 19 files from the rebuilt image, including the
NEW guildhall.bin. Do not replace default.xbe alone.

This is the new update baseline. Subsequent patches will target 1.10.0 only.
You do not need to test this checkpoint before development continues.

COMPLETED IN THIS CHECKPOINT
- Diagnostics is available without Developer Mode. Video Testing lives there.
- Companion diagnostics can isolate AI, drawing, effects, scene actors and
  portraits, set a temporary active limit of 0–3, and report sampled RAM and
  displayed-pose buffer use. These controls do not skip quests or grant recruits.
- All 19 companion families have prepared basic combat presets and original
  sprite bodies. Promotion appearances are prepared where assets are available;
  Pip now uses the original Super Novice appearance. Later recruitment remains
  tied to the unfinished campaign sections and is not enabled in normal play.
- Wizard area/single-target priorities, learned Storm Gust/Vermilion, own SP,
  shared field limits and original effects are implemented for later promotions.
- The guild noticeboard can open a separate guild interior. Completed optional
  improvements change its rooms and original furnishings. Six cabinet games
  are implemented, with saved high scores. Projects still require their story
  milestones: only the early projects unlock during the four released chapters.
  Developer testing after naming a guild can inspect the later guild projects.
- Original quest rooms remain separate from the custom guild interior.
- Timed Swordsman-trial tracking, clearer caravan directions, additional
  portraits and selected original RO cutscene emotes are included.

CAMPAIGN BOUNDARY
The first four chapters remain playable, with an explicit ending after Chapter4.
The remaining chapters, their entrances, all-map progression gates and regional
side-quest integration remain in development. They are not advertised as complete
or enabled in this checkpoint. Story details are intentionally omitted here.
Some later character artwork still awaits the previously requested references.

SAVES AND SETTINGS
Start a fresh character. Character slots now use
E:\MyROOffline\Campaign1_10_0. Older character files are ignored.
Universal audio/video/controller/screen preferences keep E:\MyROOffline and
are independent of the new character slots. The updater does not edit Xbox saves.

VALIDATION AND LIMITS
Native nxdk Xbox compilation, actual source-map and sprite decoding, host
sanitizer/controller/state checks, guild-path/arcade tests, and the shipped
PowerShell updater are checked. Companion pose-cache stress covers every
three-member combination from the full roster on the heavy-map test cases.
Host allocation measurements are not original-Xbox RAM/FPS measurements.
No new original-Xbox hardware playtest is claimed for this checkpoint.

MYRO1.2.0 - EXPANDED CLASS ASSETS

Run Collect-Expanded-Classes.cmd and select your RO client folder if prompted.
It reads the original client files and writes ZIP volumes to your Desktop.
Send ALL RO-1.2.0-Assets-Expanded-Classes ZIP volumes, including Report.json.

Requested: Ninja,Gunslinger,Taekwon,Star Gladiator,Soul Linker bodies for both
genders, their weapon/skill-icon families, available clothing palettes and
selected effect/sound families with direct dependencies. Existing verified
resources are reused by exact SHA256. No client files are modified.

No maps,party/WoE/Battleground,event or donation NPC resources requested.
Partial collections are labeled honestly; send their report too. These are
assets for implementation, not a claim that the classes are finished.

MyRO v1.2.0 - Original town NPCs and equipment services

Use Apply-Update.cmd with your MyRO v1.1.2 ISO. The updater verifies it, makes a
backup and builds MyRO-Current.iso. Upload the updated game to Xbox as usual.
Your character saves use the same format and are not changed by the updater.

This is the first portion of the remaining NPC/class work, not its completion.

Added:
- 426 additional original permanent-town dialogue NPCs, using their original
  scripts, positions and available graphics. Five original invisible map-object
  helpers can be approached and interacted with using A.
- 7 original town refiners, including Hollgrehenn in Prontera's workshop.
  They use original dialogue, ore requirements, Zeny fees, safe upgrade ranges,
  risk warnings and failure/destruction behavior. Inserted cards remain on
  successful upgrades; a failed upgrade destroys the selected item and its cards.
- 8 original town Repairmen, charging 5000z per damaged equipment copy.
- Original quest string helpers needed by further NPC integration.

Permanent-town dialogue walkthrough: 428 original scripts, 1713 controller
paths across three character/random states. Refining and repair transactions,
all enabled OnInit programs, NPC art/script streaming, current job-quest/world
integration and native Xbox build verified. Original Xbox playtesting remains.
NPC drawing keeps its existing distance culling and eight-visible-pose limit.

The five expanded classes (Ninja, Gunslinger, Taekwon, Star Gladiator and Soul
Linker) are NOT selectable yet. Their uploaded assets have been imported;
28 original class/gender/weapon variants and original progression tables are
prepared. Combat, equipment and job-quest integration still needs completion.
Dependent quests/services remain gated. Party/guild/WoE/Battleground/event
content and the donation angel remain excluded.

Includes the v1.1.2 hairstyle/colour grids and v1.1.1 feet correction.

MyRO v1.3.0 - Expanded classes

Apply this update to the released MyRO v1.2.0 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd.
The updater verifies the image, keeps a backup, and builds MyRO-Current.iso.
Upload the updated game to Xbox using your usual method. No save deletion is
required. Original Xbox is the target; physical-console testing is still needed.

Added Ninja, Gunslinger, Taekwon, Star Gladiator and Soul Linker, including their
original job-change NPCs/quests, male/female sprites, weapons, equipment rules,
ammunition, skill trees, progression, skill information and saved class state.
Existing classes and game balance settings are retained.

For quick testing: enter the Konami Code at Press A to Start, then open the
in-game developer class selector and choose Expanded Classes. Each preset gives
appropriate gear and a small supply kit below the recovery weight threshold.
For normal progression: Ninja and Gunslinger advance from Novice; Taekwon advances
through Phoenix in Payon, then branches to Star Gladiator or Soul Linker.

Ammunition defaults to automatic selection. Highlight ammunition in Items and
press X to select that type; X again restores Automatic. Selected ammunition
shows A on its icon. Ninja throws and firearm attacks consume actual supplies.
The original kunai/bullet/cartridge NPC exchanges are enabled.

Y on a skill explains its behaviour, costs, prerequisites and follow-on skills.
Star Gladiator Feel/Hate assignments are permanent and require a second cast to
confirm. Taekwon Mission progress is saved. Multiplayer-only links, paired
support, online rankings and their dependent abilities remain excluded.

Some expanded-skill effects and sounds still need visual/audio refinement.
Available original artwork is used, including Ninja fire dragon; missing source
art/sounds and remaining procedural effects are recorded for follow-up.
The broader requested menu, loot and NPC changes remain deferred as requested.

Validation: source-data/asset checks, five original job quest walkthroughs,
ammunition trades, class mechanics, both genders' kits and saves, regressions,
native Xbox build and complete updater round-trip/integrity checks.

MyRO v1.4.0 - Menus, controls and display settings

Apply this update to the released MyRO v1.3.0 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd.
The updater verifies the image, keeps a backup, and builds MyRO-Current.iso.
Upload the updated game to Xbox using your usual method. No save deletion is
required. This is a native Xbox build; physical-console testing is still needed.

The title Settings and in-game pause menu now share grouped Gameplay, Audio,
Video and Messages options. Game contains Save, Load, Return to Title and Resume.
Developer testing stays hidden unless unlocked with the Konami Code.
Use either stick or the D-pad. A/Right opens a category; Left/B returns.
For a setting, press A to edit, Left/Right to adjust, A to save or B to undo.
START resumes gameplay and cancels an unfinished edit. The darker category column,
compact side Info panel and bottom control hints replace the crowded old layout.

Audio has separate Music, Effects, Enemy Sounds and menu-navigation controls.
Enemy volume excludes hit and skill sounds. The soft Poring menu sound now has
a temporary volume slider and plays a preview when its settings are adjusted.

Video has independent Monster and Scenery Draw Range sliders, in 2-cell steps
from 8 to 72, then Screen. Fresh defaults are 36 cells; existing monster-range
preferences are retained. It also contains Scenery, original portal effects,
Minimap and Compass (SMALL/LARGE/OFF), and the existing screen-fitting window.
Portal effects use the supplied original blue ring texture with animated rings
and beams. Turning them off restores the cheaper depth-tested portal rings.
The optional additional source energy band is not included.

Gameplay contains auto-attack mode, Basic Attack First Target (Items/Enemies),
Auto target herbs, Auto loot, Autosave and both stick tolerances. Tooltips moved
to Messages. Settings are remembered separately from saved characters.

Basic Info now shows Name - Class, aligned EXP labels, bold HP/SP labels and
black resource-bar borders. Item, equipment and skill fields have darker panels.
Weight turns amber at 50% and red at 90%. MISS is smaller and fades normally.
The title's Xbox A symbol is centred. Gameplay starts fully zoomed in at midpoint
pitch; the existing camera projection is retained.

Ground loot is smaller, highlights only the targeted pile with green corners,
and a pickup scoops the whole cell. Toggle mode continues collecting within
24 cells; Cancel on Kill stops after one scoop. Walking cancels the action.
Items expire after 60 seconds, pulse red during their last 10 seconds, and clear
on map changes. Uncarried quantities remain on the ground. Auto-attack waits
for its final attack animation before facing or moving toward the next target.
Warp-location memorising is now Y in the learned Warp Portal skill's menu.

All delivered classes, NPCs and quest resources are retained. Further NPC work,
new story and companion systems are deferred. The existing hairstyle/colour
picker is retained.

Validation: menu transactions and restart persistence, controller deadzones,
audio buses, loot safety/expiry, all 46 classes' character saves, current class
and combat regressions, portal GPU state/texture bounds, HUD previews, native
Xbox build/stack checks, and the complete shipped updater round-trip.

MYRO1.5.0 MISSING ORIGINAL EFFECTS
Run Collect-Effects.cmd and select your RO client if prompted. Send ALL generated ZIP parts, even if marked partial. Reads45 named visual resources and direct STR texture/ACT sound dependencies only. No maps, NPCs, event resources or client modifications. Previously verified exact assets are reused by SHA256.

Run Collect-Sounds.cmd and select your RO client if prompted. Send all generated RO-1.5.0-Assets-Missing-Sounds ZIP parts, even if the report says partial. Reads client files only; does not modify the game. Requests only27 missing original skill WAVs, no maps or NPCs.

MyRO v1.5.0 - Effects, sound and interface fixes

Apply to the released MyRO v1.4.0 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd, as usual.
The updater verifies the input, keeps a backup and creates MyRO-Current.iso.
Upload it to your Xbox by your usual method. No save deletion is required.

Map exits now use the source map-warp effect: slow four-second blue ring pulses
and light particles, rather than the fast skill-portal effect. Skill portals
remain separate. Original portals default ON; Video retains the OFF fallback.

Added 32 original-art animation clips for the expanded classes: Ninja attack and
ground effects, Gunslinger attacks/casting/elemental mines, Taekwon Counter and
Soul Linker Estun/Eswoo, plus original thrown-item artwork. Imported 26 original
skill sounds. Fire/Ice sound variants play individually; Esma sounds are staggered.
Original SPR/ACT timing and sampled STR layers are used with bounded resident
artwork and the existing 40-instance GPU limit. This is not a claim of exact
original-client rendering for every procedural effect. One sound name in the
reference is explicitly incorrect (bash3d5.wav); it remains unavailable.

The five newest classes now advance walking animation by distance travelled,
sharing a phase between body and head. Movement speed and established class
animation are unchanged. Please check whether this resolves the reported stutter.
No camera projection changes are included.

Settings show small triangles while editing; unavailable directions are hidden.
Character selection has blue bounded page arrows and three indicators above the
centre slot, with a subtle shadow and animated blue/10% growth page selection.
The compass is transparent and sits left of the minimap at the top right, with
an outlined ring/cross and bold white, black-outlined letters. Sizes are retained.
Developer menu rows and footer no longer overlap. Equipment name backgrounds
are lowered slightly to clear slot titles.

Remaining NPC completion is deferred to 1.6.0. Existing classes, NPCs, quest,
item, enemy, map and character-save systems are retained.

Validation: native Xbox build and stack reserve, source asset hashes, original
1.4 resource-prefix preservation, effect decoding/CRC/crop bounds and draw limits,
class-specific residency, sound scheduling, distance-driven walking, portal GPU
packets/texture bounds, menu/page controls, HUD layouts and the actual updater
round-trip. Physical Xbox and xemu playtesting are still needed.

MyRO 1.6.0 - original NPC book texts

Run Collect-NPC-Books.cmd and send the generated ZIP, even if marked PARTIAL.
Requests existing book text pages for source book IDs 7755 (Nameless Island quest), 11018 and 11019 (Splendide/Manuk service descriptions).
Archives/client files are read only. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
Output is a uniquely named ZIP on the Desktop. No maps, save files or unrelated documents are requested.

﻿MyRO1.6.0 missing NPC quest and service sounds

Run Collect-NPC-Sounds.cmd. It requests only29 missing WAV files referenced by original solo NPC quests, including musical puzzles and cow milking. Your client is unchanged. Send all output ZIP parts.

﻿MyRO 1.6.0 - missing solo quest monster art

Run Collect-Quest-Monsters.cmd beside the included files.
Requests ten original monster sprite/action pairs needed by remaining solo quests, plus directly referenced sounds. It does not modify the client. Send every ZIP part produced; partial collections include an honest missing-file report.

MyRO1.6.0 seasonal resources
Run Collect-Seasonal.cmd beside the supplied files. Select your RO client if asked.
Requests10 named maps and4 NPC sprite pairs plus direct references. Does not modify the client.
Send all output ZIPs even if partial. No guild/WoE map requested.

MyRO1.6.0 original solo arena maps - corrected collector
Run Collect-Solo-Arenas.cmd. Send all ZIP outputs, even if partial.
Requests8 named solo-arena maps and direct references; does not change the client.
This fixes validation of legitimate hyphenated map names such as force_1-1.
No PVP/party/guild/WoE maps are requested.

MyRO1.6.0 original solo arena maps
Run Collect-Seasonal.cmd. Send all ZIP outputs, even if partial.
Requests only8 named solo-arena maps and direct references.
No PVP/party/guild/WoE maps; client is read-only.

Ragnarok Offline / MyRO v1.6.0

Apply to the released MyRO v1.5.0 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd, as usual.
The updater verifies the image, keeps a backup and produces MyRO-Current.iso.
Transfer the updated game to Xbox using your usual method. No save deletion is required.

Included:
- Revised, clearer HUD/menu text, controller button symbols, inventory/equipment
  spacing, HP/SP/EXP formatting and compass North indicator.
- Independent Map, Scenery, Monster and NPC draw ranges:16-128cells in steps of2,
  then Screen; all default64cells. Audio/video preferences save separately from characters.
- Closer camera zoom bounds and a slightly lower minimum pitch, retaining the
  established projection and default pitch. Developer-only Diagnostics submenu.
- Developer level reductions and corrected Thor Guardian attack timing.
- Swordsman test ledges/falls, missing checkpoint/pit links and other original
  solo quest-room links. Original script-controlled warp visibility/travel.
- Kafra/Zonda storage, save, transport and cart services; item metadata remains intact.
- Original regular airships, solo arena courses, additional city conversations
  and selected original quest groups, including Nameless Island and its prerequisites.
- Missing quest-monster art/data and original NPC sound cues. Biolabs random MVP
  encounter uses a saved10-minute countdown while dead, including offline time.
- Approved seasonal content follows the Xbox date, beginning30days before each
  holiday and ending on its configured final day. Ordinary town appearance returns afterward.

Unfinished NPC integrations and dependent systems remain disabled and move to v1.7.0.
Party-only, Guild, WoE, Battleground and donation content remain excluded.

Validation includes the native Xbox build, bounded audio/art/HUD checks, original
NPC script and encounter tests, Swordsman course topology, seasonal/date tests,
and reconstruction of the exact ISO with the shipped updater. Physical Xbox
playtesting of this release remains for you; these checks do not substitute for it.

Ragnarok Offline / MyRO v1.6.1

Apply to the released MyRO v1.6.0 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd.
The updater verifies the image and keeps a backup. Transfer the updated game
using your usual Xbox workflow. No character reset is needed.

UI repairs:
- Restored original inventory slot shadows instead of the replacement grey boxes.
- Compact Basic Info window, with tighter spacing and aligned EXP rows.
- Inventory and skill footers stay inside their windows; equipment text rows
  and shaded fields no longer collide.
- Windows draw in front of the hotbar and quick slots.
- Text fitting measures the actual native-size Tahoma glyphs it draws.
  Removed repeated text overstrikes that made letters look heavy or blotchy.
- Controller labels centred by their ink bounds, including R. Button references
  also render in the older HUD text path; icons fit their text line height.
- Developer Mode title text snaps to whole pixels, matching Start and Settings.
  Small visual adjustment to the title-screen A glyph.

This patch retains the released1.6.0 gameplay, NPCs, graphics projection and
hardware audio backend. New quests/UI, NPC integrations, class/Guardian animation
work, developer rate controls, camera tuning and optimization continue in1.7.0.
Native compilation and host checks do not replace testing on a physical Xbox.

Window placement:
Highlight a window frame without entering its contents, then move it using the
right stick. Click L3 to restore that window's default position. Positions stay
on screen and save with the individual character, including reloads.

Ragnarok Offline / MyRO v1.6.2

Apply to the released MyRO v1.6.1 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd.
The updater verifies your image and keeps a backup. Use your usual Xbox upload
workflow afterward. Existing character saves remain compatible.

Priority bug-fix and performance comparison patch:
- Display now has Closest zoom, Farthest zoom, and Starting/current zoom sliders.
  Higher values bring the camera closer. Press A to edit, left/right to adjust,
  A to save or B to cancel. Limits keep Farthest <= Starting <= Closest.
  Zoom settings save globally and are also available through title Settings.
  Default starting zoom is much less extreme; default outward zoom is tighter.
- Video > Guardian graphics switches between Sprites and Original. Sprites is
  the default. Both Sword Guardians and Bow Guardians are covered.
- Original 3D poses/textures baked into8facings at a shallow downward viewing
  angle, with alpha transparency and restrained dark outlines.7384frames total,
  40Hz source density (twice the sampled ordinary-enemy median), bounded existing
  crop streaming/cache. Size calibrated to the original models' standing height.
  Sprite attack playback is2x; rapid hits do not reset every opening frame.
- Original mode retains the3Dmodels and uses a bounded shared decoded-pose cache
  to avoid repeated reads/decompression when multiple Guardians have different poses.
- Original portals stay ON; the redundant Video toggle is removed.
- Gold compass with drop shadow, extended points and larger forked North pointer.
- Includes all1.6.1UIrepairs and per-character saved window positions.

For comparison, stand in the same Thor3location with the same zoom/draw ranges,
then switch Guardian graphics between Sprites and Original. Compare FPS and
responsiveness. The visual conversion and cache passed host/native checks;
actual Xbox improvement still needs testing. This does not claim to solve every
crowded-map stall. Other class-turning and combat-timing investigation continues.

No unfinished1.7NPCorquestintegrations are included.

MyRO v1.6.3
Apply to the released 1.6.2 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd. Keep a backup.

- Display now provides Min Zoom, Max Zoom, and Current / Default Zoom on a shared scale; larger values mean closer. Confirming the current field saves that starting zoom. B cancels the entire preview.
- Both Guardian sprites now use three times the resolution in each dimension while preserving their world size.
- Fixed Guardian attack, hit and death sequences holding their first frame. Original 3D mode remains available.

Validated with native Xbox compilation and actual streamed sprite data tests. Physical Xbox performance and appearance need player testing. The broader skill mechanics audit is separate and is not included in this patch.

Double-click Collect-Monster-Races.cmd. This requests only gon_test and its map dependencies for the original Gonryun solo monster challenge. Reads client/archive files without changing them. Send all generated ZIP volumes.

Double-click Collect-Monster-Races.cmd. This requests only que_bingo and its map dependencies, needed for Eukran and the original Hugel quest. It reads your client/archive files without changing them. Send all generated ZIP volumes. The multiplayer bingo activity remains outside this solo build.

MyRO1.7.0 original Monster Race map resources
Run Collect-Monster-Races.cmd, select your RO client if prompted, and send all ZIP parts it creates. This collects only p_track01/p_track02 and their direct graphics dependencies. It does not modify the client. I can continue other work while these are collected.

Run Collect-Quest-Text.cmd. Send all resulting RO-1.7.0-Assets-Quest-Text ZIP volumes, even if marked partial. Requests only original quest journal names/objectives and optional quest-info tables. Client files are read only.

Run Collect-Monster-Races.cmd. This follow-up collects only the original4_F_RACING guide/distributor sprite and animation, plus any directly referenced sounds. Send its output ZIP. It does not modify your client.

Double-click Collect-Monster-Races.cmd. This requests gef_fild13, used by the original solo Crusader Shrink quest, plus the still-missing race guide artwork4_f_racing. It reads client resources without changing them. Send all generated ZIP volumes. Only the field and quest NPC are needed for the quest; this does not request WoE scripts.

MyRO v1.7.0
Apply to the released 1.6.3 ISO using Apply-Update.cmd. Select your existing 1.6.3 game ISO; the updater verifies it, keeps a backup and builds MyRO-Current.iso. Upload/mount the rebuilt game using your usual method. This is an original-Xbox build, also usable in xemu. Game saves are not edited by the updater.

# HP and SP recovery

The Test49 recovery implementation used flat 1-point ticks and restarted timers
after casting, attacks, damage and movement. Test50 replaces it with the supplied
pre-renewal Hercules rules (commit `21b27966cfc2e7df0bf8151cd717a1105d047ba9`).

Reference: `server/src/map/status.c`, `status_calc_regen_pc` (2579),
`status_calc_regen_rate_pc` (2813), and `status_natural_heal` (13135), plus
`battle.c` defaults `natural_healhp_interval`, `natural_healsp_interval`,
`natural_heal_skill_interval`, and `natural_heal_weight_rate`. No supplied battle
configuration overrides these defaults.

| Channel | Amount | Standing interval | Sitting interval |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Natural HP | `1 + VIT/5 + maxHP/200` | 6 seconds | 3 seconds |
| Natural SP | `1 + INT/6 + maxSP/100` | 8 seconds | 4 seconds |
| Increase HP Recovery | `5*rank + rank*maxHP/500` | 10 seconds | 10 seconds |
| Increase SP Recovery | `3*rank + rank*maxSP/500` | 10 seconds | 10 seconds |
| Spiritual Cadence HP | `4*rank + rank*maxHP/500` | Inactive | 10 seconds |
| Spiritual Cadence SP | `2*rank + rank*maxSP/500` | Inactive | 10 seconds |

All divisions truncate to integers; VIT/INT include job and status bonuses. At
INT 120 or above natural SP adds `4 + (INT-120)/2`. Magnificat halves the natural
SP interval, including sitting; it does not change passive recovery.

Walking preserves natural SP recovery. Natural HP needs Moving HP Recovery and
then takes 12 seconds. Walking pauses ordinary HP/SP recovery passives. Casting,
stationary attacking, recent damage and recent SP spending do not independently
block recovery. Paused channels retain their partial elapsed time, without
accumulating time while ineligible. Full resources cannot bank recovery ticks.

At 50% carried weight or more, ordinary natural/passive recovery stops. Monk's
sitting-only Spiritual Cadence still works, every 20 seconds, following the
source ordering. Poison blocks all recovery unless Slow Poison is active.
Death, Hiding and Cloaking block all channels. Performing, Maximize Power,
Fury and Asura's five-minute penalty stop natural SP recovery only. Statuses
from future transcendent classes and unsupported equipment recovery modifiers
are not invented here.

`Recovery50` stores six integer millisecond clocks; the simulation's fractional
millisecond remainder is carried forward. There are no float format strings,
`lroundf` calls or floating point GPU parameters. Zoning preserves the partial
clocks; loading time does not count. Disk saves contain no recovery clocks.

`test_regen50.c` checks exact boundaries and amounts through `combat_tick`, for
all 21 jobs, including rank-10 Wizard/Priest SP Recovery, movement, sitting,
weight thresholds, retained fractions, status gating, INT120, Magnificat,
Spiritual Cadence, full resources and zoning. Production combat hooks are used; this is not a claim that the remaining class
integration has been released.

# HP and SP recovery

The Test49 recovery implementation used flat 1-point ticks and restarted timers
after casting, attacks, damage and movement. Test50 replaces it with the supplied
pre-renewal Hercules rules (commit `21b27966cfc2e7df0bf8151cd717a1105d047ba9`).

Reference: `server/src/map/status.c`, `status_calc_regen_pc` (2579),
`status_calc_regen_rate_pc` (2813), and `status_natural_heal` (13135), plus
`battle.c` defaults `natural_healhp_interval`, `natural_healsp_interval`,
`natural_heal_skill_interval`, and `natural_heal_weight_rate`. No supplied battle
configuration overrides these defaults.

| Channel | Amount | Standing interval | Sitting interval |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Natural HP | `1 + VIT/5 + maxHP/200` | 6 seconds | 3 seconds |
| Natural SP | `1 + INT/6 + maxSP/100` | 8 seconds | 4 seconds |
| Increase HP Recovery | `5*rank + rank*maxHP/500` | 10 seconds | 10 seconds |
| Increase SP Recovery | `3*rank + rank*maxSP/500` | 10 seconds | 10 seconds |
| Spiritual Cadence HP | `4*rank + rank*maxHP/500` | Inactive | 10 seconds |
| Spiritual Cadence SP | `2*rank + rank*maxSP/500` | Inactive | 10 seconds |

All divisions truncate to integers; VIT/INT include job and status bonuses. At
INT 120 or above natural SP adds `4 + (INT-120)/2`. Magnificat halves the natural
SP interval, including sitting; it does not change passive recovery.

Walking preserves natural SP recovery. Natural HP needs Moving HP Recovery and
then takes 12 seconds. Walking pauses ordinary HP/SP recovery passives. Casting,
stationary attacking, recent damage and recent SP spending do not independently
block recovery. Paused channels retain their partial elapsed time, without
accumulating time while ineligible. Full resources cannot bank recovery ticks.

At 50% carried weight or more, ordinary natural/passive recovery stops. Monk's
sitting-only Spiritual Cadence still works, every 20 seconds, following the
source ordering. Poison blocks all recovery unless Slow Poison is active.
Death, Hiding and Cloaking block all channels. Performing, Maximize Power,
Fury and Asura's five-minute penalty stop natural SP recovery only. Statuses
from future transcendent classes and unsupported equipment recovery modifiers
are not invented here.

`Recovery50` stores six integer millisecond clocks; the simulation's fractional
millisecond remainder is carried forward. There are no float format strings,
`lroundf` calls or floating point GPU parameters. Zoning preserves the partial
clocks; loading time does not count. Disk saves contain no recovery clocks.

`test_regen50.c` checks exact boundaries and amounts through `combat_tick`, for
all 21 jobs, including rank-10 Wizard/Priest SP Recovery, movement, sitting,
weight thresholds, retained fractions, status gating, INT120, Magnificat,
Spiritual Cadence, full resources and zoning. Production combat hooks are used; this is not a claim that the remaining class
integration has been released.
